correctness.rationale: A Zorn-model computation gives rank-one centralizers for nonisotropic traceless elements and 3-dimensional imaginary Heisenberg centralizers for isotropic elements. This forces imaginary rank <= 2 for commuting tuples, identifies both closed irreducible incidence loci with dimensions 2s+6 and 3s+5 and their null-rank-one intersection dimension 2s+5. The null projective quadric has [6]_q rational directions, each on q+1 planes, yielding [6]_q planes; disjoint rank strata prove the exact formula. Reproduced q=3,5 exhaustive adjoint-rank counts; checked Heisenberg cases and symbolic all-arity identities. No claim of scheme-theoretic radicality or characteristic-two extension.
